scenes.say: Car service centre owners. Gaadi kab milegi, din mein tees call aate hain?
Customer ko bas do cheezein chahiye. Kya ho raha hai, aur kitna kharcha.

scenes.title: 1. Teen *status* message:
scenes.name: Your Service Centre

msgs.text: ✅ *Gaadi aa gayi*. Job card 📎 Estimate: ₹[X]. Shaam 6 baje tak.
⚠️ Brake pad ghise hain: *₹2,400* extra. Photo 📎 Reply YES/NO

scenes.say: Gaadi aate hi job card. Extra kaam pe photo ke saath approval. Aur ready hote hi bill.

scenes.title: 2. *Extra kaam* ka rule:
scenes.say: Extra kaam pe pehle photo, exact amount, aur yes aane ke baad hi kaam. Bill pe jhagda khatam.

scenes.text: Bill pe *surprise*. Customer *agli baar* nahi aata.
scenes.say: Sabse badi galti. Bill pe surprise. Woh customer agli baar nahi aata.
Comment karo STATUS, teeno templates bhejenge. Ya seedha WhatsApp karo, hum aapke liye set kar denge.

caption:
Service centre mein aadha din "gaadi kab milegi?" wale calls mein jaata hai. Aur bill pe surprise se customer hamesha ke liye chala jaata hai. 🚗

Business of the Day: Car service centre
1️⃣ Gaadi aate hi: job card + estimate + time
2️⃣ Extra kaam: photo + exact ₹ + YES ke baad hi kaam
3️⃣ Ready: bill + pickup time
❌ Galti: bill pe surprise
